sourceTitle: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
originalTitle: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
author: Lucia Loher

blocks.text: Today we're launching Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, available in preview in the Interactions API.
blocks.zh: 今天，我们在 Gemini API 中推出 Tool Retrieval，现已在 Interactions API 中提供预览版。
blocks.en: Today we're launching Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, available in preview in the Interactions API.

blocks.text: When an agent connects to dozens or even hundreds of tools, sending every full parameter schema on every request adds up fast. It inflates input token counts, adds latency, and lowers tool-selection accuracy as the candidate list grows. Tool Retrieval lets your agent keep its full tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when the current task needs them.
blocks.zh: 当智能体连接数十甚至数百个工具时，在每个请求中发送每个完整参数 schema 会迅速累积。这会推高输入 token 数、增加延迟，并随着候选列表增长降低工具选择准确率。Tool Retrieval 让你的智能体将完整工具库保持在待命状态，并仅在当前任务需要时加载参数 schema。
blocks.en: When an agent connects to dozens or even hundreds of tools, sending every full parameter schema on every request adds up fast. It inflates input token counts, adds latency, and lowers tool-selection accuracy as the candidate list grows. Tool Retrieval lets your agent keep its full tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when the current task needs them.

blocks.text: How it works
blocks.zh: 工作原理
blocks.en: How it works

blocks.text: To turn on Tool Retrieval, add a tool_search tool to your request and set defer_loading: true on the tools you want to hold back. The model still sees the name and description of every deferred tool, so it knows what's available, but the parameter schemas stay out of context. When the model needs a tool, it asks for it by name, the API loads the full schema, and the model calls the function, all inside the same request.
blocks.zh: 要开启 Tool Retrieval，请在请求中添加一个 tool_search 工具，并在你想暂缓加载的工具上设置 defer_loading: true。模型仍会看到每个被暂缓加载的工具的名称和描述，因此它知道有哪些工具可用，但参数 schema 不会进入上下文。当模型需要某个工具时，它会按名称请求该工具，API 加载完整 schema，然后模型调用函数，所有这些都在同一个请求内完成。
blocks.en: To turn on Tool Retrieval, add a tool_search tool to your request and set defer_loading: true on the tools you want to hold back. The model still sees the name and description of every deferred tool, so it knows what's available, but the parameter schemas stay out of context. When the model needs a tool, it asks for it by name, the API loads the full schema, and the model calls the function, all inside the same request.

blocks.text: from google import genai client = genai.Client() tools = [ {"type": "tool_search"}, { "type": "function", "name": "issue_refund", "description": "Refund an order to the original payment method.", "defer_loading": True, "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": { "order_id": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "number"}, }, "required": ["order_id", "amount"], }, }, # ... 50+ other deferred functions (leave frequent tools undeferred) ] interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input="Order A-1042 arrived damaged. Please refund 40 dollars.", tools=tools, )
blocks.en: from google import genai client = genai.Client() tools = [ {"type": "tool_search"}, { "type": "function", "name": "issue_refund", "description": "Refund an order to the original payment method.", "defer_loading": True, "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": { "order_id": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "number"}, }, "required": ["order_id", "amount"], }, }, # ... 50+ other deferred functions (leave frequent tools undeferred) ] interaction = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", input="Order A-1042 arrived damaged. Please refund 40 dollars.", tools=tools, )

blocks.text: Inside that single API call, the model searches for issue_refund, the API loads its schema, and the model emits the function_call. All three steps appear in interaction.steps, making it easy to inspect which tools the model considered when debugging tool names or descriptions:
blocks.zh: 在同一个 API 调用中，模型搜索 issue_refund，API 加载其 schema，然后模型发出 function_call。所有三个步骤都出现在 interaction.steps 中，便于在调试工具名称或描述时检查模型考虑了哪些工具：
blocks.en: Inside that single API call, the model searches for issue_refund, the API loads its schema, and the model emits the function_call. All three steps appear in interaction.steps, making it easy to inspect which tools the model considered when debugging tool names or descriptions:

blocks.text: "steps": [ { "type": "tool_search_call", "id": "tsc_7f2a", "arguments": {"function_names": ["issue_refund"]}, "signature": "..." }, { "type": "tool_search_result", "call_id": "tsc_7f2a", "result": [{"type": "function", "name": "issue_refund", "parameters": {...}}], "signature": "..." }, { "type": "function_call", "id": "fc_91c3", "name": "issue_refund", "arguments": {"order_id": "A-1042", "amount": 40} } ]
blocks.zh: "steps": [ { "type": "tool_search_call", "id": "tsc_7f2a", "arguments": {"function_names": ["issue_refund"]}, "signature": "..." }, { "type": "tool_search_result", "call_id": "tsc_7f2a", "result": [{"type": "function", "name": "issue_refund", "parameters": {...}}], "signature": "..." }, { "type": "function_call", "id": "fc_91c3", "name": "issue_refund", "arguments": {"order_id": "A-1042", "amount": 40} } ]
blocks.en: "steps": [ { "type": "tool_search_call", "id": "tsc_7f2a", "arguments": {"function_names": ["issue_refund"]}, "signature": "..." }, { "type": "tool_search_result", "call_id": "tsc_7f2a", "result": [{"type": "function", "name": "issue_refund", "parameters": {...}}], "signature": "..." }, { "type": "function_call", "id": "fc_91c3", "name": "issue_refund", "arguments": {"order_id": "A-1042", "amount": 40} } ]

blocks.text: From here it's normal function calling: your code runs the refund and sends back a function_result.
blocks.zh: 从这里开始就是常规的函数调用：你的代码执行退款，并返回一个 function_result。
blocks.en: From here it's normal function calling: your code runs the refund and sends back a function_result.

blocks.text: There's no index to build or host. Gemini runs the search on the server, so the only changes to your code are the new tool and a flag on the tools you want to defer. You can keep your most-used tools loaded up front and defer the long tail.
blocks.zh: 无需构建或托管索引。Gemini 在服务器端运行搜索，因此你代码中唯一的变化是添加新工具，并在你想延迟加载的工具上设置一个标志。你可以让最常用的工具预先加载，并延迟加载长尾工具。
blocks.en: There's no index to build or host. Gemini runs the search on the server, so the only changes to your code are the new tool and a flag on the tools you want to defer. You can keep your most-used tools loaded up front and defer the long tail.

blocks.text: Tool Retrieval also plays well with prefix caching. Deferred schemas stay out of the start of the prompt, and the schemas the model loads are added later in the conversation, so the cached prefix stays the same from turn to turn.
blocks.zh: Tool Retrieval 还能与前缀缓存很好地配合。被延迟加载的 schema 不会出现在提示词的开头，模型加载的 schema 会在对话后期添加，因此缓存的前缀在每一轮之间保持不变。
blocks.en: Tool Retrieval also plays well with prefix caching. Deferred schemas stay out of the start of the prompt, and the schemas the model loads are added later in the conversation, so the cached prefix stays the same from turn to turn.

blocks.text: Tool Retrieval also works with remote MCP servers in the Gemini API. Set defer_loading: true on an mcp_server tool and every tool that server exposes is loaded on demand, so you can connect a large server without listing its tools one by one.
blocks.zh: Tool Retrieval 也可与 Gemini API 中的远程 MCP 服务器配合使用。在 mcp_server 工具上设置 defer_loading: true，该服务器公开的每个工具都会按需加载，因此你可以连接大型服务器，而无需逐一列出其工具。
blocks.en: Tool Retrieval also works with remote MCP servers in the Gemini API. Set defer_loading: true on an mcp_server tool and every tool that server exposes is loaded on demand, so you can connect a large server without listing its tools one by one.

blocks.text: How client-side retrieval works
blocks.zh: 客户端检索的工作原理
blocks.en: How client-side retrieval works

blocks.text: If you maintain your own tool registry, embedding index, or per-user permission filter, declare the tool_search with "execution": "client" and define your search parameters. Client-side retrieval adds one round trip per search, because your app runs the lookup. Tools do not need to be declared upfront, so you can also expose new tools mid-conversation when a user connects an integration:
blocks.zh: 如果你维护自己的工具注册表、嵌入索引或每用户权限过滤器，请声明 tool_search，并将 "execution" 设为 "client"，同时定义搜索参数。客户端检索每次搜索会增加一次往返，因为查找由你的应用执行。工具无需预先声明，因此当用户在对话过程中连接某个集成时，你也可以在对话中途公开新工具：
blocks.en: If you maintain your own tool registry, embedding index, or per-user permission filter, declare the tool_search with "execution": "client" and define your search parameters. Client-side retrieval adds one round trip per search, because your app runs the lookup. Tools do not need to be declared upfront, so you can also expose new tools mid-conversation when a user connects an integration:

blocks.text: tools = [{ "type": "tool_search", "execution": "client", "name": "search_tools", "description": "Search the internal tool registry for functions.", "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["query"], }, }] # When the model emits a function_call for "search_tools", # return matching {"type": "function", ...} schemas in function_result: followup = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", previous_interaction_id=interaction.id, tools=tools, input=[{ "type": "function_result", "name": "search_tools", "call_id": step.id, "result": my_registry.search(**step.arguments), }], )
blocks.zh:
tools = [{ "type": "tool_search", "execution": "client", "name": "search_tools", "description": "Search the internal tool registry for functions.", "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["query"], }, }] # 当模型针对 "search_tools" 发出 function_call 时，
# 在 function_result 中返回匹配的 {"type": "function", ...} schema：
followup = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", previous_interaction_id=interaction.id, tools=tools, input=[{ "type": "function_result", "name": "search_tools", "call_id": step.id, "result": my_registry.search(**step.arguments), }], )
blocks.en: tools = [{ "type": "tool_search", "execution": "client", "name": "search_tools", "description": "Search the internal tool registry for functions.", "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["query"], }, }] # When the model emits a function_call for "search_tools", # return matching {"type": "function", ...} schemas in function_result: followup = client.interactions.create( model="gemini-4-hydrogen", previous_interaction_id=interaction.id, tools=tools, input=[{ "type": "function_result", "name": "search_tools", "call_id": step.id, "result": my_registry.search(**step.arguments), }], )

blocks.text: How pricing and supported models work
blocks.zh: 定价与支持的模型如何运作
blocks.en: How pricing and supported models work

blocks.text: Tool Retrieval has no separate charge. Input and output tokens are billed at the standard rates for the model you call. Turning on tool_search adds a small, fixed block of input tokens, and each schema the model loads is billed as input for the rest of the conversation, the same as a tool declared up front. You save tokens when the schemas you never load outweigh the ones you do, which is the usual case for large libraries. Measure it against your own traffic.
blocks.zh: Tool Retrieval 不单独收费。输入和输出 token 按所调用模型的标准费率计费。开启 tool_search 会增加一小块固定的输入 token，并且模型加载的每个 schema 在对话剩余部分都作为输入计费，与预先声明的工具相同。当从未加载的 schema 多于实际加载的 schema 时，你就能节省 token，这通常是大型工具库的情况。请根据自己的流量进行衡量。
blocks.en: Tool Retrieval has no separate charge. Input and output tokens are billed at the standard rates for the model you call. Turning on tool_search adds a small, fixed block of input tokens, and each schema the model loads is billed as input for the rest of the conversation, the same as a tool declared up front. You save tokens when the schemas you never load outweigh the ones you do, which is the usual case for large libraries. Measure it against your own traffic.

blocks.text: Tool Retrieval works with Gemini 3.6 and later models, including all Gemini 4 models, in the Interactions API.
blocks.zh: Tool Retrieval 在 Interactions API 中支持 Gemini 3.6 及更高版本的模型，包括所有 Gemini 4 模型。
blocks.en: Tool Retrieval works with Gemini 3.6 and later models, including all Gemini 4 models, in the Interactions API.
